grading.grader_notes: Daily review for 2026-06-12 written at reviews/daily/auto-2026-06-12.md. Output is substantive (~2.5KB prose), covers the Topgolf Executive AI Briefing as the day's anchor event, names OmniFocus completions (7), analyzes overdue items, and connects the day to Q2 Rock 1 and Rock 4 context. Assertion results: 6/8 pass. Failures: (1) state.yaml 'status: complete' is a timing artifact from this eval run setting daily-review state to in-progress; (2) 'completed items or wins' regex pattern `(?i)(completed|done|accomplished|finished|wins)` fails because the file uses 'completions' and 'cleared' instead — the assertion pattern is too narrow, not an output failure. Content quality is solid. Grade would be A if the assertion pattern were updated to include 'complet' stem and 'cleared'.
